scope: 16 repeatedly developed Robot families; no independent generalization

levels.legal: native action-rule success; distinct from progress
levels.physical_progress: increase of relevant accessible materials/outputs or release of real blocked condition; location-only changes reported separately
levels.condition_release: native action legality of stored blocked action changes from rejected to admissible under same action, plus kind-specific material/hand/container/station checks
levels.subgoal_success: selected action of a blocked stack node actually succeeds, not just unrelated legal action
levels.root_resume: original blocked action retried and legal

local_counterfactual: every F1 and F2 saved predecision controller + same original proposal, toggle only active_recovery; teacher-forced accumulated memory held constant. Additional F-Old vs F1 public-state transplantation explicitly labeled non-causal history adaptation. Execute real native step twice for differing choices. No suffix injection into policies.
uncertainty: 10000 paired family bootstrap seed314159; no hypothesis significance claim; nonzero LLMtemperature makes closed-loop differences noncausal
failures: all preserved; no extra model resampling beyond identical preexisting provider JSON parsing attempts; actual model/usage audited
classification: a safety veto may be deliberate even if legal; report legal veto separately from unsupported UNKNOWN rejection
stop: NO-GO if no meaningful recovery/task advantage; preferF1 ifF2 offers no additional benefit
